name: Kagi
guidance: Kagi supports site:, filetype:, inurl:, intitle:, quotes, AND/OR, exclusions, wildcards and bangs. Bangs may redirect outside Kagi.

name: Google
guidance: Use plain queries, quotes, site:, filetype:, intitle:, inurl: and exclusions. Do not assume Kagi bangs are supported.

name: Bing
guidance: Use plain queries, quotes, site:, filetype:, intitle: and exclusions. Do not assume Kagi bangs are supported.

name: Yahoo
guidance: Prefer plain queries, quotes and site:. Other operators vary; do not assume Kagi bangs are supported.

name: DuckDuckGo
guidance: Use plain queries, quotes, site: and exclusions. DuckDuckGo has bangs, but they may redirect to another site and differ from Kagi.

name: Brave
guidance: Use plain queries, quotes, site:, filetype: and exclusions. Do not assume Kagi-specific bangs are supported.
